title: 第364章 危机解除第365章 龙威练神
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
lines: 陨火流星雨的轰鸣，整整持续了十分钟。
林奇不清楚外面的局势，也不敢有丝毫停手。
他不知道奥尼克斯和罗伊是否还在抵抗，怕自己一停手，就会遭到两人的反扑。
哪怕源力消耗殆尽，也只能硬撑着。
可十分钟之后，他再也撑不住了，浑身的经脉都在叫嚣着疼痛，不得不停下了攻击。
“到极限了吗....”
林奇扶着冰冷的地面，缓缓瘫倒在地。
他额头上布满了冷汗，每一次呼吸，都牵扯着全身的经脉，带来撕裂般的剧痛。
“六千枚源晶，我的身体最多只能承受这么多源晶的暴力吸收，一旦超过，不用敌人动手，我自己就会经脉断裂而死。”
他能清晰地感觉到，
体内的经脉像是被滚烫的岩浆灼烧，又像是被锋利的刀刃切割，每一寸都在隐隐作痛。
在这个世界，经脉断裂不可怕，可怕的是没有人给他治疗。
“如果梅比斯在的话，我应该还能继续。”
阿特拉斯之盾渐渐消散，四周重新陷入浓得化不开的黑暗。
林奇的精神探查着四周，心中满是诧异。
持续十分钟的陨火流星雨，威力足以将地面炸得千疮百孔。
可这里的环境，却仿佛没有受到任何影响。
没有残留的火焰，没有坑坑洼洼的痕迹，甚至连一丝炽热的温度都没有，依旧是冰冷刺骨的死寂。
“不愧是封印魔龙的地方，就是不知道当初设下这个封印的人，该是多么的强大。”
林奇躺在冰冷的地面上，缓缓喘息，足足缓了十分钟，身体的剧痛才稍稍缓解了一些。
这十分钟里，他甚至已经在脑海中做好了最坏的打算。
他该如何投降、如何忽悠对方，才能暂时保住性命，等待突围的机会。
可等了半天，预料中的攻击并没有出现。
“猩红妖藤。”
林奇费力抬手，召唤出一根藤蔓。
猩红妖藤立刻向着前方大范围横扫。
“呼呼。”
一阵破空声响起，猩红妖藤大范围的扫荡一番，并没有碰到任何障碍物。
林奇长长舒了一口气，悬着的心终于放了下来，重重地躺回地面。
“看来是逃走了。”
刚一放松，身体上的剧痛再次袭来，让他倒吸一口凉气，额头的冷汗又冒了出来。
“御卡宗师，果然还是不一样。”
林奇觉得自己还是大意了。
content_en:
The roar of the meteor shower lasted for ten minutes.
Lin Qi didn't know the situation outside and didn't dare to stop at all.
He didn't know if Onyx and Roy were still resisting, and he was afraid that if he stopped, they would counterattack.
Even if all the source power is exhausted, he can only hold on.
But ten minutes later, he couldn't hold on any longer, and all the meridians in his body were screaming in pain, so he had to stop the attack.
"Have you reached your limit..."
Lin Qi held on to the cold ground and slowly collapsed to the ground.
His forehead was covered with cold sweat, and every breath pulled at the meridians throughout his body, causing severe pain like tearing.
"With six thousand source crystals, my body can only withstand the violent absorption of so many source crystals. Once it exceeds, my own meridians will be broken and I will die without the enemy taking action."
He could clearly feel,
The meridians in his body felt like they were being burned by hot lava, or like they were being cut by a sharp blade. Every inch of his body felt a dull pain.
In this world, it is not scary to have a broken meridian. What is scary is that no one will treat him.
"If Mavis is here, I should be able to continue."
The shield of Atlas gradually dissipated, and the surroundings fell into darkness that was too thick to break.
Lin Qi mentally explored the surroundings, filled with surprise.
The volcanic meteor shower that lasted for ten minutes was powerful enough to blast the ground full of holes.
But the environment here seems to have not been affected in any way.
There was no residual flame, no trace of pits, not even a trace of hot temperature, it was still a biting cold silence.
"It is indeed the place where the magic dragon is sealed, but I don't know how powerful the person who set this seal must be."
Lin Qi lay on the cold ground, breathing slowly for ten minutes before the severe pain in his body eased slightly.
In these ten minutes, he had even prepared the worst case scenario in his mind.
How should he surrender and how should he deceive the other party in order to temporarily save his life and wait for the opportunity to break out?
But after waiting for a long time, the expected attack did not appear.
"Scarlet demon vine."
Lin Qi raised his hand with great effort and summoned a vine.
The scarlet demonic vine immediately swept forward in a wide area.
"Huhu."
There was a sound of breaking through the air, and the scarlet demonic vine swept across a wide area without encountering any obstacles.
"Hoo~"
Lin Qi breathed a long sigh of relief, finally relieved of his worries, and lay down heavily on the ground.
"It seems he escaped."
"Hiss!"
As soon as he relaxed, the severe pain in his body hit him again, making him take a breath and cold sweat broke out on his forehead again.
"Master Yuka, it is indeed different."
Lin Qi felt that he was still careless.
